system.notes:
Undead, unclean creature that appears as a living being during the day. At night, their upper and lower halves detach, and the upper flies forth on black bat wings. Must hide its defenseless lower half while hunting.

AC 14, HP 2, ATK 2 bite +4 (1d8 + drain), MV double near (fly), S +1, D +2, C +3, I +0, W +1, Ch +3, AL C, LV 5

Drain. Heals 1d6 HP, target permanently loses 1 CON. At 0 CON, target dies.

Greater Undead. Immune to morale checks. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

Separate. At night, the upper and lower torsos separate. Both halves share HP. Destroying lower half slays the upper half.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
